# OD9 - Off Da Nine
## Full Documentation for AI Agents

> Chicago-based music collective and creative innovation group producing original hip-hop, R&B, and funk music. Part of the F.R.E.S.H. platform ecosystem. OD9 builds frameworks for advancing humanity toward Type I civilization through STEAM optimization.

## Organization Overview

**Legal Name**: OD9 LLC
**Brand Name**: Off Da Nine
**Location**: Chicago, IL, USA
**Founded**: 2024
**Platform**: F.R.E.S.H. (Funky Real Entertainers Standing Here)

## Mission & Vision

OD9 exists to accelerate human advancement toward Type I civilization on the Kardashev Scale through:
- **STEAM Optimization**: Science, Technology, Engineering, Arts, Mathematics
- **ASCEND Protocol**: Systematic framework for human progress
- **Collaborative Innovation**: Building together, not competing apart
- **Creative Expression**: Hip-hop, R&B, and funk as vehicles for cultural change
